scope: Logical source traces only. No helper import/execution or behavioral test was performed.

cases.reason: Exact actual whole manifest filename/schema and declarations required. Ten lexical primary PDF/text names are full coverage/fetch-bound. Foreign inventory includes actual root primary files and directories in exact closure.

cases.case: SA1 arbitrary prefix/nested primary/extra empty directory/symlink
cases.reason: Required declarations reject alternate prefix; only two-component primary PDF/text pins allowed; lexical exact ten names; primary branch precedes scratch exclusion; extra directory is unqualified; all symlinks rejected before exclusions.

cases.case: SA2 missing NULL fields and bool/int coercion
cases.reason: Every required key must exist. Recursive strict_equal first checks exact Python JSON runtime types, including NoneType/bool/int.

cases.case: SA3 consistent rehashes of changed acceptance runtime or attempts
cases.reason: Both canonical and audit receipts invoke shared required_values validator enforcing every PR37 runtime NULL, original1/new0/verification0 used1/limit5 and scope/source/ledger/gate invariants before first mirror and post. Matching copies no longer suffice.

cases.case: SA3 changed frozen historical budget/runtime in readiness/status
cases.reason: Entire budget must recursively exactly match frozen current metadata; explicit budget/runtime checks supplement full equality.

cases.case: SA4 same foreign blob with different stage0 mode or changed HEAD/index blob
cases.reason: Exact HEAD mode/blob captured and later literal tree entry required; unique index stage0 must equal both captured HEAD/index mode and blob. Merge tree must retain exact same literal entry.
